title: Privacy Notice
subtitle: Notice on the processing of personal data on the stressindex.io website, under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

sections.title: Controller
sections.body:
{company}, {address}, VAT and tax code {vat}, certified email (PEC) {pec}.
Privacy contact: {privacyEmail}.
Data protection officer: appointment in progress; in the meantime write to {privacyEmail}.
Support: {email}.

This page covers the website and the professional area. Processing in the app is described in the App privacy notice; client data entered by the professional are processed by us as processor, under the Data Processing Agreement (DPA).

sections.title: Browsing the website
sections.body:
• IP address, pages visited, browser, operating system and time, in server logs. To deliver the website, security and abuse prevention. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)). Retention: only as long as strictly necessary, according to the hosting provider's settings.
• Website technical errors (Sentry): page, browser, error message and pseudonymous identifier, without data entered in forms. To fix malfunctions. Basis: legitimate interest. Retention: 90 days.
• Technical session and language cookies. They do not require consent; details are in the Cookie Policy.

The website uses no profiling cookies, advertising tools or traffic analytics that identify the visitor.

sections.title: Trial registration
sections.body:
• First name, last name, email, encrypted password, profession, practice name. To create the professional account and start the trial. Basis: contract (Article 6(1)(b)). Retention: account lifetime plus 30 days.
• Consents accepted, with version, text fingerprint, date, IP and user agent. To demonstrate them (Article 7(1)). Basis: legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c)). Retention: account lifetime plus 5 years.
• Email for marketing communications, only if you tick the dedicated consent (Article 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.title: Professional area
sections.body: In the professional area you consult your clients' data as controller; we process them as processor under the DPA. Server functions run in the Frankfurt region and data are stored in Frankfurt.

sections.title: Email contacts
sections.body: If you write to {email} or {privacyEmail} we process the data you send us to reply. Basis: contract or legitimate interest. Retention: 24 months after the request is closed. Do not send your clients' health data by email: use the platform features.

sections.title: Providers and transfers
sections.body:
The providers that process data on our behalf are listed, with location, service, data location and safeguards, on the Providers that process data page, updated with 30 days' notice. Data are stored in the European Union; providers based in the United States process data on the basis of the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

We do not sell data or disclose them to third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Encryption in transit and at rest; each professional accesses only their own data through row-level policies; two-factor authentication for administration tools; immutable log of administrative access; automatic backups, overwritten within 35 days.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
You can request access (Article 15), rectification (16), erasure (17), restriction (18), portability (20), object to processing based on legitimate interest (21) and withdraw consents at any time, without affecting processing already carried out. Write to {privacyEmail}: we reply within 30 days.

You can lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it) or the authority of your country.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We inform you of any relevant change; material changes require new acceptance at your next login. This is a translation: in case of any discrepancy, the Italian text prevails.
